rows: What they must be able to do
Approve figures by writing notes next to them
Mark problems with comments, but never change values
Only read the delivery route for tomorrow
Leave comments on contract dates without editing them
Write feedback in comments on student work
Suggest improvements in comments only, no edits
Only check which orders are planned
Change delivery dates when a truck is late
Add new rows for every meeting
Add and change data, share the file with others
